summary: This directory centralizes the definition of analytical metadata and scoring parameters used to evaluate and prioritize documentation. It provides structured interfaces that quantify domain-specific relevance and signal importance for the analysis engine.
responsibilities: Defining semantic indicators for domain analysis
Providing scoring metadata for documentation prioritization
relationships: Domain signals provide semantic context that informs how documentation is weighted.
Score hints define the parameters that the analysis logic uses to rank documentation priority.
designDecisions: Use of TypeScript interfaces to enforce schema consistency for analytical data
Separation of domain indicators from prioritization scoring logic
